description:
## Goal

Shared UI helpers that scenarios import to declare widgets type-safely and apply `data-widget` attributes.

## Expected Work

- Typed TS helpers for declaring a widget entry (id, description, category, tags).
- Helper that produces the `data-widget` attribute value type-safely so drift between declaration and usage is a compile error.
- Live in the existing shared UI package (iframe-bridge-adjacent, per the `fewer packages` decision).
- Documentation / example snippet.

## Acceptance

- A sample scenario UI can declare a widget in `ui/src/widgets.ts`, apply the typed data attribute in a React component, and have iframe-bridge advertise it via the new handshake.
name: widget-authoring-ui-package
title: Ship UI helpers for declaring widgets (widgets.ts + typed data attributes)
